ObjectName.value: Parked bicycles in front of the football cage between Entrepotdok and LaagteKadijk in the city Amsterdam; urban photography in the Netherlands, Fons Heijnsbroek 2013 (10904779616)

Categories.value: CC-Zero|Created with Adobe Photoshop Elements|Hoogte Kadijk, Amsterdam|PD-Netherlands|Voetbalkooi Geschutswerf|Metal fences|Street photography in Amsterdam|Uploads by Matlin|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2|Autumn in Amsterdam|Bicycles in Amsterdam|Trees in Amsterdam|Photographs by Fons Heijnsbroek in Amsterdam (2013)|Kadijken neighbourhood of Amsterdam, in photos by Fons Heijnsbroek

ImageDescription.value:
Photo of parked bicycles in front of the football cage and green plane trees, location: between Entrepotdok and Hoogte Kadijk in old city Amsterdam.
In my view this is a bike-parade, a bicycle show in front of a large and open space. The picture presents a nice intertwined balance of nature green and metallic constructions from the fence and the collection of parading bikes. They appear very individualistic, standing in an personal posture, as talking with each other while the dog is roaming for himself. It is mid-Autumn and the plane leaves in the tree crowns are still rather green. On the background is located Artis Zoo with its many trees. Photo in free download and high resolution of Amsterdam city, the Netherlands by street photographer Fons Heijnsbroek, 2013.
